SELECT
  cn.name AS producing_company,
  miidx.info AS rating,
  t.title AS movie
FROM
  company_name AS cn
  INNER JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = cn.id AND ct.kind = 'production companies'
  INNER JOIN info_type AS it ON it.info = 'rating'
  INNER JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id AND mi.movie_id = miidx.movie_id
  INNER JOIN movie_info_idx AS miidx ON miidx.movie_id = mi.movie_id
  INNER JOIN title AS t ON mi.movie_id = t.id
  INNER JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id AND cn.id = mc.company_id
  INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM company_type WHERE kind = 'production companies') AS ct_prod ON ct_prod.id = mc.company_type_id
  INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM info_type WHERE info = 'release dates') AS it_dates ON it_dates.id = miidx.info_type_id
  INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM kind_type WHERE kind = 'movie') AS kt_movie ON kt_movie.id = t.kind_id
WHERE
  cn.country_code = '[us]' AND miidx.movie_id = mc.movie_id
